hook: Carbon dots carrying a chiral catalyst drive asymmetric reactions to 93% e.e. and can be reused
summary: Carbon dots with a chiral organocatalyst attached act as both light absorber and handedness controller for making one mirror-image product. They gave up to 84% yield and 93% e.e., were recovered by precipitation and reused five times, and ran in a flow reactor tuned by Bayesian optimization. Only one reaction type (aldehyde alkylation) was tested.
title: Conjugate Chiral Carbon Dots for Scalable Asymmetric Photocatalysis in Flow
venue: Journal of the American Chemical Society
